name: MetaDragon token-id transfer unrestricted minting
summary: P404Token treated any transfer value below 30,001 as an ERC-721 token ID. When the recipient was the token contract itself, _update skipped ERC-20 balance accounting, called the linked collection's burn without checking that the caller owned the NFT, and minted 9,800 MetaDragon tokens to msg.sender. The attacker repeated this over existing token IDs and sold the unbacked mint into the MetaDragon/WBNB pair in 12 transactions.

loss.notes: The 12 successful campaign receipts each contain exactly one WBNB Transfer: a payout from MetaDragon/WBNB pair 0x0a86a9cc823f8febc1d26f1f880be3c986e7c042 to attack helper 0xdaef6079cb84405dac688a9f6956c6830b7ddbc6. Those exact realised payouts sum to 301.983523984473584116 WBNB; no WBNB enters the pair from the attacker in the transaction set. The USD value uses the nearest DefiLlama BNB observation preceding the anchor.

ageReset.description: The direct deployment fixed the token-ID branch, self-recipient transform path, missing caller ownership check, and unconditional ERC-20 mint. The linked ERC-721 and owner are constructor-set, and later allowlist, supply, NFT, liquidity, and trading changes do not alter that public path.

sources.note: Reviewed all successful and reverted transactions sent by the exploit EOA to its helper during the campaign, the anchor's full trace, every successful receipt, commit-pinned reproduction, explorer-verified P404Token source, archive supply, balances and code, direct creation receipt, proxy slots, and pre-exploit runtime history. Verified source defines isValidTokenId(value) as value < 30001. For such a value, _update skips super._update; if to is the P404Token itself or its linked ERC-721, it calls transform(value), whose _erc721ToErc20 branch calls the ERC-721's burn(value) and then _mint(msg.sender, 9,800e18) without checking NFT ownership. In the anchor, attack helper 0xdaef6079cb84405dac688a9f6956c6830b7ddbc6 made 400 ordinary transfer(token, value) calls to the P404Token; 374 existing token IDs succeeded, 26 missing IDs reverted only their low-level subcalls, and 374 Transfer events minted 3,665,200 MetaDragon tokens to the helper before its swap. The trace independently shows the P404Token call linked ERC-721 0x336a7675a863c12f7b49061b3ecb9e54be5e2120 burn(uint256) 400 times with those same 26 failures. The same EOA/helper completed 12 successful mint-and-dump transactions from block 39141427 through 39141482, followed by five reverted attempts. Their receipts contain 4,380 successful zero-address mints totaling 42,924,000 MetaDragon; totalSupply rose by that exact amount from 241,706,600 tokens before the anchor to 284,630,600 after the last success. Each successful receipt contains one WBNB transfer from pair 0x0a86a9cc823f8febc1d26f1f880be3c986e7c042 to the helper, and their exact sum is 301.983523984473584116 WBNB. Artifact history: 0xef1f39d8391cddcaee62b8b383cb992f46a6ce4f was directly created by 0x27851617ac8fd50a8328a16f864912905c4cb4fb in block 38391440 index 83, timestamp 1714717330. Code is absent at block 38391439, and its 8,715-byte runtime hashes to 0xfc2b94720b1c2f587418ef6c7583b8eba920d241cb6e3248dedb5cc5fa59f596 at deployment and immediately before exploitation. Explorer metadata marks it non-proxy, both EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots are zero, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, CREATE, CREATE2, or SELFDESTRUCT. Constructor-fixed linkage and later allowlist, NFT, supply, liquidity and trading changes do not change the unrestricted self-transfer mint path, so deployment is the latest age reset 2,255,095 seconds before exploitation.

notes: Replaces the seed row's rounded $180,000 estimate with the complete 12-transaction campaign's exact WBNB proceeds.
